adjudications.title: P1 loader accepts inconsistent duplicated acceptance metadata
adjudications.root_note: Re-signed inconsistent duplicate metadata; nested numerical replay remains valid and downstream FSO rejects the false-negative flag.

adjudications.title: Acceptance report output can overwrite an input artifact
adjudications.root_note: Input artifact is overwritten by --report, then revalidation fails; scratch-only public CLI probe.

adjudications.title: Acceptance artifact ancestry check is vulnerable to parent symlink replacement
adjudications.root_note: Forced concurrent parent symlink replacement; not an ordinary immutable input path.

adjudications.title: Acceptance manifest permits one artifact path to be counted in multiple cases
adjudications.root_note: Cross-case shared files can be intentional. No independent-case or uniqueness promise was established.

adjudications.title: Caller precondition: range geometry coordinates are projected metre inputs
adjudications.root_note: Projected-metre input is a documented caller precondition; the resolver does not certify arbitrary CRS.

adjudications.title: Known historical scaffold note: builder/product activation genesis digests differ
adjudications.root_note: Existing DEP-002 in nonauthoritative historical deployment scaffold; not a new P0 current-product defect.

adjudications.title: Intervention context omits source availability and can edit source-unavailable cells at zero physical norm
adjudications.root_note: Supported separate raw/source masks permit a no-effect raw correction with zero physical norm; normal pre-intersected producers limit occurrence.

adjudications.title: Malformed common-bias metadata is treated as diagonal observation error by the intervention guard
adjudications.root_note: Wrong-type raw analysis JSON; typed AnalysisConfig already rejects it.

adjudications.title: Benchmark loads verification NPY without an input resource or shape preflight
adjudications.root_note: Operator benchmark memory preflight opportunity. Post-run RSS/time thresholds are not proven hard input budgets; no OOM exercised.

adjudications.title: Manual MPS regression resolves an unpinned PyTorch version
adjudications.root_note: Optional MPS workflow has unpinned Torch resolution; reproducibility issue, not a demonstrated backend numerical failure.

adjudications.title: Case-insensitive raw-ingestor keys are accepted but normal receipts are compared by spelling
adjudications.root_note: Accepted upper-case key hex disagrees with lower-case receipt producer; availability/config normalization.

adjudications.title: Episode listing orders timezone-offset strings lexically rather than by instant
adjudications.root_note: Aware timestamps with different offsets sort incorrectly as raw strings.

adjudications.title: ModelContract runtime type checks are missing for annotated provenance fields
adjudications.root_note: Wrong annotated provenance field type; no numerical or compatibility bypass demonstrated.

adjudications.title: Operational mosaic provenance accepts a valid source-coverage artifact from another issuance plan
adjudications.root_note: Cross-plan signed coverage accepted at operational provenance boundary; final normal holdout rechecks plan/mask. Current operational inference unsupported; no full decision fixture.

adjudications.title: Concurrent duplicate operational provenance append fails in the history side effect
adjudications.root_note: Concurrent identical provenance append fails idempotent history side effect; retry availability, not wrong forecast.

adjudications.title: Operational issuance has no raw trust checkpoint on its final return
adjudications.root_note: Static final-check timing hypothesis. A check always has a later return interval; no full public race or linearization-point violation established.

adjudications.title: A crash after replay-directory publication can permanently wedge retry
adjudications.root_note: Existing crash/retry candidate; source publication order known, typed process-death/restart reproduction still missing.

adjudications.title: M0 active-set mask is not enforced against retained direct maps or nonemptiness
adjudications.root_note: Malformed externally supplied snapshot; normal producer has nonempty active support and masks maps.

adjudications.title: M0 tile L2 summaries are not checked against the corresponding map tiles
adjudications.root_note: Malformed tile norms can disagree with maps; normal producer derives them correctly.

adjudications.title: M0 direct observation impact is only checked for tile sum, not direct map times innovation
adjudications.root_note: Malformed impact can disagree with map times innovation; normal producer guarded.

adjudications.title: Supplying source availability alone rejects the internally defaulted quality weights
adjudications.root_note: Root reran public variational_nowcast: omitted quality rejected, explicit source-masked zero quality accepted.

adjudications.title: Publication can emit forecasts below the state support-presence threshold
adjudications.root_note: Initial same-coordinate source-time/lead-time comparison invalid. Correct remap found no valid cell composed entirely of undefined state. Only configurable cutoff semantics remains.

adjudications.title: Resolved source coverage accepts input and full-analysis digests unrelated to the scored run
adjudications.root_note: Coverage caller metadata accepted early, but final holdout compares input/full digests (13729-13737); original unguarded-scoring claim narrowed.

adjudications.title: Operational analysis-input provenance plans permit duplicate site/time slots that later make derivation impossible
adjudications.root_note: Malformed duplicate site/time plan rejected later by derivation; early-validation consistency.

adjudications.title: Weighted training target loss can overflow on supported floating-point inputs
adjudications.root_note: Root public probes: ordinary FP16 256x256 failure; FP32 representable weighted result becomes inf, masked-out extreme finite prediction produces NaN.

adjudications.title: Physical-event catalog membership availability is not bound before scoring
adjudications.root_note: Availability timestamp mismatch accepted before scoring; final promotion rejects it. No final statistical bypass.

adjudications.title: Holdout scoring silently floors off-grid sensitivity leads to another forecast frame
adjudications.root_note: Floor indexing confirmed in helper and caller traced. Full signed public holdout fixture not assembled.

adjudications.title: Top-level issuance-change policy fractions use score support instead of operational publication masks
adjudications.root_note: Publication vs scoring support mismatch confirmed in helper/caller; full signed public promotion not executed.

adjudications.title: Prior uncertainty support and clear-sky scoring drops valid below-detection censored cells
adjudications.root_note: Point weights exclude all censored samples. Need event-specific interval/threshold semantics; never treat every censored sample as known clear. Full public promotion counterexample absent.

adjudications.title: Offline operational decision validation accepts a mismatched authority trust-store digest
adjudications.root_note: Signed wrong digest accepted offline; ordinary issuer writes current digest and current operational inference unsupported.

adjudications.title: Promotion ledger sequence validation allows sequence two to point at genesis
adjudications.root_note: Signed sequence-2/genesis inconsistency accepted offline; live ledger checks predecessor.

adjudications.title: Runtime activation validation does not enforce runtime expiry at or before release approval expiry
adjudications.root_note: Signed expiry pair outside normal issuer contract; runtime closure/file metadata patched in probe. No live deployment claim.

adjudications.title: Zero-background velocity regression leaves the control update unconstrained
adjudications.root_note: Local zero-background test weak; other control/JVP tests partly cover mutant.

adjudications.title: Canonical-observation regression checks finiteness without checking that data affects the residual
adjudications.root_note: Local finite-only test weak; exact observation residual oracles exist elsewhere.

adjudications.title: Censored FSO score regression has only zero residuals and reuses the score helper as its oracle
adjudications.root_note: Local zero-residual/self-score test weak; nonuniform nonzero M0 oracles exist elsewhere.

adjudications.title: Unresolved ldd dependencies are silently omitted from the sealed native closure
adjudications.root_note: Synthetic ldd unresolved-entry omission; known historical native-closure concern, not an actual broken Linux runtime.

adjudications.title: Runtime closure validation can block indefinitely on a special file
adjudications.root_note: FIFO helper hang reachable from stdlib or metadata-owned files in malformed runtime; normal regular-file wheels unaffected.

adjudications.title: audit_transport accepts a supplied moved field with a different grid shape
adjudications.root_note: Explicit moved= wrong-shape diagnostic input; internal normal nowcast constructs the matching grid.

adjudications.title: Current v16/v22 observation-error replay omits source-composed spatial quality and uncertainty for v15 inputs
adjudications.root_note: Root reran current v22 public fixture; spatial quality/std omission confirmed. Temporal runtime role requires explicit separation from source-selection certification.

adjudications.title: Observation mask and error replay validators use torch.equal without enforcing tensor dtype
adjudications.root_note: torch.equal dtype-insensitivity at standalone replay boundaries; normal current VerificationBundle dtype guard rejects these mutations.

adjudications.title: Observation-removal replay drops the nominal neural prior and source-availability input
adjudications.root_note: Root reran successful public removal vs re-inferred retained prior: scores .04431874046394474 vs .015242213929648809. Separate source-mask omission less fully exercised.

adjudications.title: Radar-dependent prior fallback is omitted from the physical initial-background derivative
adjudications.root_note: Partial-prior fallback physical channel missing despite +.01 actual initial-state change. Exploratory FSOI uses relaxed curvature tolerance; branch unknown, not certified learning.

adjudications.title: Zero Taylor probe is accepted and reports perfect linearity
adjudications.root_note: Zero Taylor delta measures no variation; trivial linearity=1 alone is not an independent validation. Config semantics, not forecast arithmetic.

adjudications.title: Episode-impact schema migration test never verifies that existing rows survive
adjudications.root_note: Migration fixture has no historical rows; not a reproduced data-loss bug.

adjudications.title: Holdout-plan clock-crossing test does not assert transaction rollback
adjudications.root_note: Clock-rejection test lacks rollback assertions; not a reproduced commit-after-rejection.

adjudications.title: Standalone current promotion-evaluation loader has no row-list binding test
adjudications.root_note: Standalone decoded evaluation-list binding deserves direct negative test; current main promotion loader does check list/digests.

adjudications.title: Boolean background ages are accepted as minute counts
adjudications.root_note: Boolean-as-float permissiveness alone is not a demonstrated numeric failure.

adjudications.title: Issuance contract does not enforce floating PSR metadata
adjudications.root_note: Rehashed wrong-type PSR metadata; ordinary metadata producer uses expected type.

adjudications.title: Exact product type regression test covers only four of sixteen required products
adjudications.root_note: Subset of exact-type regression cases; no runtime bypass proven.

adjudications.title: Full product promotion smoke test has no independent numerical oracle
adjudications.root_note: Unpatched end-to-end replay exists. Independent final score oracle remains a narrower opportunity.

adjudications.title: Replay dtype/device tests bypass the durable loader and append boundary
adjudications.root_note: Specific tests stop before persistence; do not infer all durable paths are untested.

adjudications.title: Semantic replay regression test replaces the shipped scorer with a fixture lambda
adjudications.root_note: Named test patches scorer; an unpatched integration test exists at 3270-4880.

adjudications.title: Quantized and conditional PIT tests accept constant wrong numerical outputs
adjudications.root_note: Retain PIT-value oracle gap only. Independent NLL oracles reject constant nll=1.

adjudications.title: Family-wide simultaneous uncertainty test checks metadata but never checks statistical bounds
adjudications.root_note: Full family/key oracle weak; other finite-sample bound and bootstrap-invariance tests exist.

adjudications.title: Operational geometry and partition tests stop at the permanent unsupported-deployment boundary
adjudications.root_note: Geometry names hide deliberate unsupported deployment stop; no current unsafe deployment.

adjudications.title: Public single-site range resolver accepts a tampered geometry contract without checking its digest
adjudications.root_note: Forged frozen single-site geometry contract reaches resolver; ordinary constructors and holdout plan digest guard present.

adjudications.title: Candidate event-catalog binding test is tautological
adjudications.root_note: Tautological positive catalog test; producer has real mismatch checks.

adjudications.title: Legacy joint-min routing Brier is still an acceptance gate despite the diagnostic-only contract
adjudications.root_note: README diagnostic-only joint-min conflicts with current conjunctive gate. Helper numbers/caller confirmed, full signed alternate-probability fixture absent.

adjudications.title: Sample-size preflight accepts incomplete metric and issuance cell maps as feasible
adjudications.root_note: Explicit empty preflight maps accepted; normal compute path generates complete maps.

adjudications.title: Current v22 source-composed quality and uncertainty are never asserted by the confirmatory fixture
adjudications.root_note: Coverage evidence for A5-01; not a second product defect.

adjudications.title: M0 observation uncertainty is tested only for availability, so wrong whitening scale remains GREEN
adjudications.root_note: M0 whitened numerical scale oracle weak, producer test currently availability focused.

adjudications.title: Current-generation inverse-variance weighting has no independent numerical oracle in the verification tests
adjudications.root_note: Current-generation weight composition needs independent numeric expectation; A5-01 is concrete motivating case.

adjudications.title: Frozen P0 dynamics sensitivity drops accepted censored observations
adjudications.root_note: Root reran same-adjoint crosscheck: 28 accepted censored cells, public map 0 vs unmasked max195673.1732. Nondefault thresholds, frozen branch unknown.

adjudications.title: VariationalAdjointConfig accepts Boolean values for float trust parameters
adjudications.root_note: Boolean numeric input permissiveness does not itself establish numerical/learning failure.

adjudications.title: P1 confidence regression test is self-consistent with a zero posterior
adjudications.root_note: Independent Hessian and zero-information covariance tests exist. Nontrivial public posterior-to-physical conversion remains weak.

adjudications.title: Final polished stationarity test trusts producer-reported diagnostics
adjudications.root_note: Named polished diagnostic test self-consistent; other robust-gradient and sensitivity stationarity oracles partly cover path.

adjudications.title: Operational posterior-dynamics saturation fallback has no regression test
adjudications.root_note: Specific saturation rejection test absent; no runtime failure established by test absence alone.

adjudications.title: Pixel footprint radii and common-bias tile size have no grid or resource cap
adjudications.root_note: Explicit extreme footprint/tile settings; allocation calls intercepted before OOM, no ordinary-case resource failure.

adjudications.title: Radial physical-motion control has zero AD sensitivity at exact speed saturation
adjudications.root_note: Crossreview reached exact cap with normal estimator initialization; inward robust objective AD near0 vs finite decrease. One-sided boundary issue, no final solver false acceptance reproduced.

adjudications.title: Accepted large pseudo Huber deltas collapse finite residual cost and gradient to zero
adjudications.root_note: Root public raw20/21/20 inputs, FP32delta2e38 orFP64delta1e308: expected quadratic limit1.125, currentcost/gradient0; defaultdelta unaffected.
